title: Attachment repository
interface: class AttachmentRepository(conn). create(owner_type, owner_id, kind, filename, stored_name, mime_type, size, uploaded_by) -> dict. get(id) -> dict | None. list_for(owner_type, owner_id) -> list[dict] ordered by id. delete(id) -> bool. count_for(owner_type, owner_id) -> int. Dict keys: id, owner_type, owner_id, kind, filename, stored_name, mime_type, size, uploaded_by, uploaded_at. the repository receives a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and calls conn.commit() after every write; rows are plain dicts

uses.schema: src/db.py: SCHEMA — tables employees, locations(id,name,address,notes), tags(id,name,color), invoices(id,number,supplier,issued_at,total,currency,notes,created_by,created_at), asset_tags(asset_id,tag_id), assets(+location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id, updated_at), handovers, assignments, audit_log, attachments(id,owner_type,owner_id,kind,filename,stored_name,mime_type,size,uploaded_by,uploaded_at), settings
